verdict.rationale: GitHub docs confirm Codex CLI supports API key authentication as an alternative to ChatGPT account login, but note it 'requires additional setup,' and the account-login flow (Sign in with ChatGPT) is the recommended default. Missing for 10: detailed API-key setup documentation, first-party quickstart parity with account login, and independent confirmation that API-key auth is fully feature-equivalent (e.g. codex-comm-5 shows some newer models aren't even available via API yet).
